paragraphs.text: ⚠️ NOT REVIEWED BY ANY HUMAN - AI-generated (DeepSeek V4.1-flash). DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc
.2 (Windows) bundle: gives the ACL sandbox runner a console so confined pwsh/cmd/powershell start ag
ain under workspace-write. No confinement is relaxed. dsh-plugin.
# dsh-sandbox-console-fix
> ## Update (2026-10-19): this bundle is **not** needed on a non-elevated Harness — repository archi

ved
>
> The failure this bundle works around is gated by the **elevation of the process that launche

s the
> sandbox runner**, not by the Default DACL alone. Measured on the reporting machine with the

> byte-identical shipped runner:
>
> | how the runner was launched | token's Default DACL | `workspa

ce-write` result |
> | --- | --- | --- |
> | elevated (UAC disabled) | `{Administrators, SYSTEM, <lo

gon SID>}` | `3221225794` (`0xC0000142`) |
> | non-elevated (UAC enabled) | `{<user>, SYSTEM, <logon

SID>}` | **works** — three repeats |
>
> Neither token's Default DACL contains `Everyone`. On a **n

on-elevated** Harness the shipped runner
> already starts confined `workspace-write` children, so th

is bundle is unnecessary there; it has been
> uninstalled from the reporting machine. It remains a w

orkaround for **elevated** hosts (UAC disabled,
> or the Harness launched as administrator), where t

he failure is still real.
>
> The structural fix belongs upstream: one line in `setTokenDefaultDaclG

rant` (see Harness discussions
> #9038 / #8775). Upstream #9280 and #9282 were closed as *outdated*

with this correction.
> This repository is **archived** and kept for the record only. *(AI-generated
, not human-reviewed.)*

> **Windows only.** A DeepSeek Harness bundle that
> makes the confined sandbox usable on the deskto

p app: `workspace-write` shell calls start again, and
> `read-only` keeps working — **without relaxi

ng any confinement**. Both of this bundle's patch rows are
> platform-guarded, so on Linux/macOS the

composition is untouched and the package is inert.
>
[该节后续省略]
## Root cause and what this bundle does
The restricted token that runs the confined child gets **one** extra full-access ACE merged into its

Default DACL: `tempWriteSidPtr ?? writeSidPtr ?? worldSid` — the capability write SID in
`workspace

-write`, `Everyone` in `read-only`. On a host whose process token's Default DACL lacks
`Everyone`, a

child that has to create a console during DLL initialization dies with `0xC0000142` — and
it only h
as to when the sandbox runner owns no console (the packaged desktop app's Electron host).
**Primary mechanism (since 0.2.0).** The shim runs inside the runner process *before* the runner der

ives
the restricted token, and merges `Everyone` into that process token's Default DACL. The restric

ted token
inherits it, which is exactly what the shipped `read-only` path already does — so no conso

le handling is
needed at all.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility

| Platform | Windows 10/11, x64 |
| Harness | **DeepSeek Harness desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`** (Electron 44
.0.0 / Node 24.18.1) — the subclass overrides one method of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local@0.2.0-rc

.2` |
| Node / Electron | any (`--import` requires Node ≥ 20.6 / Electron with Node ≥ 20.6) |
| Upst

ream report | <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9280> |
| Other platforms
| the override is never called; the package is inert |
Because it subclasses a Harness-internal class, re-check after a Harness upgrade — the upstream fix
(see the issue report) makes this package unnecessary.
## Security
The bundle does not widen file authority, and this is measured rather than argued: with the Default-

DACL
merge applied, writes to `%USERPROFILE%`, the drive root, `C:\Windows\Temp` and the user temp d

irectory
are still denied and the files are absent, while an in-workspace write succeeds. What chang

es is only the
runner process token's **Default DACL**, which gains one `Everyone` full-access ACE —

the same ACE the
shipped runner already merges on its `read-only` path. The restricting SIDs, the L

ow integrity label, the
workspace and private-temp grants, the denial ACEs and the fs policy are unt

ouched, and the shim performs
no process creation and no environment change. It writes one file only

when
`DSH_SANDBOX_CONSOLE_FIX_DEBUG` is explicitly set to a path, for support. Every failure is swa

llowed so
the runner keeps its shipped behaviour.
## Security review (three adversarial rounds, 2026-10-11)

This is an **AI self-review, not a human audit**. Three attack/fix/functional-test rounds were run
a
gainst the installed bundle; every finding below was reproduced before it was fixed, and every fix w

as
re-tested against the same attack.
| Finding | Severity | Status |
| A bare `require('koffi')` resolved from this plugin's ancestor directories — all writable by any l
ocal process — so a planted package executed inside the sandbox runner (**outside** the sandbox). Re
produced. | High | Fixed: koffi is now resolved only from inside the running Harness installation. |
| `index.js` loaded `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` through the same walk-up chain, unvalidated; a
planted class runs inside the Harness process and controls `windowsAclRunnerInvocation()`. Reproduc
ed. | High | Fixed: the resolution's realpath must be inside this plugin's own `node_modules` or the

dsh profile root. |
| The diagnostic env var wrote an arbitrary absolute path, truncating any exist
ing file. Reproduced. | Medium | Fixed: the diagnostic now emits one stderr line and performs no fil

e writes. |
| A missing or unreadable shim was preloaded unconditionally, so the runner failed to st
art and **every** sandboxed command failed. Reproduced. | Medium | Fixed: the shim's existence is ch

ecked before it is preloaded. |
| The merge's re-read only compared the ACE count, so a silent `SetT
okenInformation` no-op would be reported as success. | Medium | Fixed: the Default DACL is now walke

d and the ACE must name `Everyone` **and** carry `FILE_ALL_ACCESS`. |
| Token handle, SID and merged

ACL were never released. | Low | Fixed: `CloseHandle` + `LocalFree`. |
| The `EXPLICIT_ACCESS_W` la
yout is 64-bit; other architectures were not excluded. | Low | Fixed: the merge is skipped off x64 a

nd the console fallback is used. |
| The fallback's standard-handle restore had no per-step protecti

on. | Low | Fixed: each step is individually guarded. |
[该节后续省略]
